get.summary: Retrieve account history by PAYE reference.
get.description: Returns the account history for a given PAYE reference.

parameters.name: payeRef
parameters.description: The PAYE reference to retrieve account history for.

200.description: Successful response. Returns the account history object.

404.description: Account history not found for the provided PAYE reference.

AccountId.description: The ID of the account associated with the PAYE reference.

AddedDate.description: The date the PAYE reference was added.

RemovedDate.description: The date the PAYE reference was removed.

ApiRoles.name: Authorization
ApiRoles.description: API roles required to authorize access.
